College of Engineering
Welcome to the Frank H. Dotterweich College of Engineering. Home of the Javelina Engineers.
Explore our Engineering Programs
We've made it easy for you to access more information and take control of your future. Discover different engineering majors that could lead to your dream career. Accelerate your career by diving into opportunities like our graduate programs, including the Fast Track MS Program. We offer several graduate degrees across our six departments to help you achieve new heights. Following link opens up the webpage that provides details of all our undergraduate, Masters, PhD, Minor and Certificate programs. Once there, click on the program that most interests you to take the next step in your academic journey today!
Engineering Programs
Message from the Dean
It is my pleasure to welcome you to the Frank H. Dotterweich College of Engineering! Whether you are a student, researcher, faculty member, or scientist, the College of Engineering can provide you with multiple pathways to reach your goals. Since 1936, we have offered South Texas access to world-class educational excellence in engineering and technology.
More Info
Dr. Heidi A Taboada
View our Departments
The College of Engineering offers a variety of departments and programs to choose from and our faculty and staff are always ready to guide students to reach their full potential. Connect with Department Chairs and departmental administrators to go more into depth about your academic and career goals.

Engineering Academic Advisors
Connect with your Academic Advisor today and set yourself up for success! Get personalized guidance, course planning, degree roadmaps, and the one-on-one support you need to achieve your academic goals.

Javelina Engineering Student Success Center
With so many majors in the College of Engineering to choose from, we understand it can be challenging to decide which one works for you. We recommend students think first about their desired career and then consider which majors can lead them there. The best part is that we have a full center dedicated to helping students find answers to their questions as they take their first steps into their academic journeys.
